verses.1: And the word of Jehovah was spoken to Jonah, son of Amith.
verses.2: Go to the great city of Niniveh, and proclaim against it that their calamity has come upon them.
verses.3: And Yonah arose to flee from before Jehovah. Yafeh went down and found Aniah, who was with Tarsis. He gave her a reward, and then he went down with her to go with them. Tarsis also came down from before Jehovah.
verses.4: And Jehovah sent a great storm upon the sea. There was a great storm in the sea, and the ships were afraid to continue sailing.
verses.5: The sailors were afraid, and they cried out to their gods. They threw away all the food that was in the ship, so that it could be lighter for them. Then, a storm came, and the ship began to sink.
verses.6: And the chief priest came to him and said, “What are you going to do? Rise up and call upon your God. Perhaps He will save us from this disaster.”
verses.7: And they said to each other, “Let’s go down and see what kind of evil this has brought upon us.” So they went down into the valley. And the valley was filled with destruction.
verses.8: And they said to him, “Please tell us who has done this evil to us. What is your punishment? And from where will you come into your land? And who is this people of yours?”
verses.9: And he said to them, “I am Avram. I fear Jehovah, the God of heaven. He created the sea and the dry land.”
verses.10: And the people were filled with fear. They said to him, “What have you done? For the people knew that before Jehovah, he would speak through them.”
verses.11: And they said to him, “What will happen to you? The sea will rise above us because the sea is flowing and moving around.”
verses.12: And he said to them, “Take me away and throw me into the sea. The sea will wash away all of you. For I know that this great storm will come upon you.”
verses.13: And the people tried to return the ship to its place, but they couldn’t, because the sea was flowing and raging around them.
verses.14: And they called out to Jehovah, saying, “O Jehovah, please do not allow this man’s soul to be destroyed. Do not let bloodshed occur upon us, for you, O Jehovah, have done as you wished.”
verses.15: And they took Yonah and carried him to the sea. The sea rose up in anger.
verses.16: And the people feared Jehovah greatly. They offered sacrifices to Jehovah, and they served him with all their hearts.
